department: Department of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences

deadline.value: Thesis programs: international document deadline February 1 for September entry (the entrance-requirements page says March 15). Files incomplete by early March have a much lower chance of funding.

also.quote: applications that are not complete (including reference letters and transcripts) by the beginning of March stand a considerably lower chance of receiving financial support than applications completed before that time.

supervisor.value: You must secure an EAS faculty member who agrees to supervise you before applying; applications without one are rejected.
supervisor.quote: Note that the supervisor(s) you list must have agreed to supervise you. | Applications without a supervisor will be rejected.

also.quote: If no prospective supervisor expresses interest, please do not apply. | Applications without a supervisor will be rejected and application fees are non-refundable.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: A master's degree is required to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: a Master's degree is required if applying to a PhD program

notes: Two reference letters; one referee may be a potential supervisor. ESP 550 not accepted as English proof.
